components.description: Flat paper container with compact section hierarchy.

components.description: Dark native brain-viewpoint select: Image close-up is the default, followed by Full brain, Angled view, and Side view. The body retains its own menu.

components.name: Paired specimen layout
components.description: Brain and body occupy equal dark fields with independent titles and captions. The default brain image uses density-normalized whole-neuron spike activity; the live app supplies WebGL content to these canvas slots.

The body

components.name: Causal intervention controls
components.description: Native cobalt checkboxes and a separate framed pulse action preserve the distinction between two ongoing interventions and a positive-control pulse.
components.html:
Test the connection

The pulse directly stimulates DNp09 for 150 simulated ms. It is a separate positive control, independent of the video.

components.name: Live anatomical representation
components.description: Native representation select and fixed light-blur checkbox, reusing the inspector controls; these change the presentation of measured activity without source-image input.
components.html:
Each marker sits on a real neuron and uses that neuron's own spike history. Sites were selected once for coverage, independently of the video. The branch view reveals the same activity across each whole arbor.

A small, fixed blur of the emitted light. Turn it off to inspect individual sites.
components.css: .ds-live-representation{font-family:Barlow,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#242c34);}.ds-live-label{display:block;margin-top:15px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:#5a6875;}.ds-live-select{width:100%;height:36px;padding:0 9px;background:var(--paper,#f8f9fa);border:1px solid #cbd2dc;border-radius:5px;color:#293944;font:400 13px Barlow,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms,color 140ms,border-color 140ms;}.ds-live-check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:15px 0;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-live-check input{accent-color:var(--accent,#2457df);width:17px;height:17px;}.ds-live-help{margin:10px 0 0;color:#687681;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;min-height:34px;}.ds-live-representation :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6d92f0;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-live-representation :disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-live-select{transition:none;}}

components.description: Separate live neural throughput, capture-to-display-submission latency, model-time ratio, and target dimensions. Placeholders indicate unavailable measurements; no performance value is a design token.
components.html: — new neural frames/s— ms processing latency—× model time— target pixels
components.css: .ds-live-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 20px;height:auto;min-height:42px;padding:8px 0;font:400 12px Barlow,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#616d79);}.ds-live-stats strong{color:var(--ink,#242c34);font-weight:500;}.ds-live-stats span:nth-child(3){margin-left:auto;}@media(max-width:1200px){.ds-live-stats span:nth-child(3){margin-left:0;}}

narrative.overview:
The film viewing table is a quiet instrument around a vivid specimen. A pale grey surround holds the charcoal image field, source monitor, and compact controls. Barlow Condensed gives the identity and main heading a narrow, purposeful voice; Barlow keeps the working interface legible.

The visual hierarchy comes from scale and material contrast. The anatomy occupies the largest area, while cobalt marks transport, selection, and links. The source remains visibly separate from the anatomical display. Flat panels and restrained rules organize the workspace without competing with the image.
keyCharacteristics: Pale instrument surround and charcoal image field.
Cobalt for transport, selection, and interactive emphasis.
Condensed identity lettering with compact Barlow controls.
Pixel-preserving source imagery and a geometry-led main view.
Flat panels, small control radii, and explicit keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Instrument Accent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for actionable or selected interface states; allow source imagery and anatomy colors to carry their own content palette.

rules.name: The Stable Readout Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for frame, time, angle, and measured-value readouts so changing values do not shift the interface.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate persistent surfaces with tone, spacing, and fine rules. Reserve the existing shadow treatment for the transient toast.

dos: Do keep the image field visually dominant and its source preview explicitly labeled.
Do use the established Barlow pairing and compact, tabular numeric readouts.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and accessible names when mobile controls hide their text.
Do preserve source aspect and pixel edges when presenting dataset frames.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences for initial playback, interface transitions, and camera changes.
donts: Don't apply UI cobalt to replace the source image or false-color anatomy palette.
Don't add card shadows to the persistent viewing table or inspector.
Don't stretch source imagery to fill the monitor or conceal empty regions in the anatomical display.
Don't replace the implemented inline stroke icons with emoji or icon-font glyphs.
